title: Gable End — 4m Span
description: S03 modular gable end with wall-cap base and a quarter-metre terminal clay roof strip meeting the repeating roof at local Y=0. Four-metre wall-centre span, quarter-metre outward terminal strip, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual end-wall cap and repeating-roof mating evidence is retained for this visual module. No structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee. Pending independent review.
